packageRules.description: Android platform packages in one grouped PR so the diff stays reviewable.
NewPipeExtractor ships on JitPack and is versioned by upstream Git tags (v0.26.x); the custom manager below owns it, so the built-in Maven lookup must not open a second PR.

customManagers.description: The YouTube engine. It is the component that breaks first when YouTube changes its anti-bot checks, so its update should arrive as an ordinary reviewable PR rather than as a hotfix.
